newsitem.title: USA: Hilton to file ITT tender Jan. 30. [CORRECTED 00:20 GMT 30/1]
newsitem.headline: Hilton to file ITT tender Jan. 30. [CORRECTED 00:20 GMT 30/1]

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp plans to file documents outlining its $55-per-share tender offer for ITT Corp with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission by the end of the current week (corrects from on Thursday), a Hilton official said on Wednesday.
Marc Grossman, senior vice president of corporate affairs, told Reuters that Hilton had yet to be contacted by ITT management regarding the $6.5 billion bid.

ITT officials were not available for comment on Wednesday. In a statement issued earlier this week, ITT said it would make a recommendation on whether to accept or reject the Hilton's bid within 10 days of receiving the offer.
In addition, Grossman confirmed Hilton filed a lawsuit against ITT in the Ninth Circuit District Court in Las Vegas.
The suit seeks to "ensure that a fair (board) election process takes place and that any takeover defenses they have are not used improperly," he said. He declined to elaborate.
Hilton has said it would issue proxy statements and attempt to unseat ITT's current board of directors in order to complete the deal.
